pinnedFiles.reason: Lists the 11 documented helpers (waitForMapLoad, getCenter, getBounds, getMarkers, drawLine, getMarkersAlongLine, distanceBetween, isPointInPolygon, assertPopupContent, isLayerVisible, checkTileFailures) — AC2 requires at least one test per README helper, so this is the literal checklist for the suite.

The LeafletFixture implementation under test. Note it actually exposes 13 methods — dragMap and zoomMap exist here but are undocumented in the README; checkTileFailures reads a DOM class (.leaflet-tile-error) rather than intercepting network, which matters for a --network none run.
Package's public entry point (re-exports `test` and `LeafletFixture`) — confirms what the fixture page's test files will import.

Current `test` script is the literal `exit 1` this order exists to fix (AC in the spec); also the dependency list the fixture page/test runner additions must fit into (currently only leaflet, @types/leaflet, @playwright/test, typescript — no static-file server dependency exists yet).

rootDir/include are scoped to src/**/* only — confirms new fixtures/ and test files won't be pulled into the package's own `tsc` build and need their own compilation path (Playwright's test runner, not this tsconfig).

Existing consumer-app test that already exercises every one of the 11 README helpers (plus dragMap via zoomMap) against a live Leaflet map — the closest thing to a worked answer for what each new fixture-page test should assert (marker names, polygon bounds, layer-control label, distance tolerances).

Only existing example in the repo of a `channel: 'chrome'` project plus the runner-image launch-arg pattern (resolveRunnerSlowMo/resolveRunnerVideo) and a webServer block — AC4 requires the new package's own suite to run the same way, headed, in real Chrome, inside the runner image.

Read lines 1-45 and 160-180 only (file is 394 lines; the WebGL/ANGLE build-record and UBI9 sections past that are not relevant — Leaflet needs no GL context). Establishes the docker run contract (repo mounted at /work, non-root, --network none expectation, exec-based exit code) that AC4's literal docker command depends on.
